hawaii.fact: Government-contract emigration (官約移民, 1885-1894, 26 sailings, ~29,000 people) was recruited mainly in Hiroshima, Yamaguchi, Kumamoto and Fukuoka; Hiroshima supplied more than one-third of the national total.
About 30% of the 944 emigrants on the first 官約移民 sailing (1885) came from Ōshima District (Suō-Ōshima, Yamaguchi).
Wakayama: 22 of the first sailing; in 1924, 38% of all fishermen on Oahu were Wakayama-born (Kushimoto/Tanami).

Okinawa: first group left Naha 1899-12-05, arrived Honolulu 1900-01-08; 26 contract labourers, 10 of them from Kin. Kin village sent 3,225 emigrants (Hawaii, Philippines, N. America, Brazil, Peru etc.) up to 1941.
A 1905 essay reproduced by the National Diet Library ranks Hawaii emigrants: Hiroshima most, then Kumamoto, Nagasaki, Fukuoka, Yamaguchi, Okayama, Wakayama.

us_mainland.fact: From the 1890s emigration shifted to California (higher wages); Wakayama emigrants from Naga district (via the 共修学舎 study group) and southern Kii; ~3,000 Nikkei lived on Terminal Island (Port of Los Angeles), mostly Wakayama-born and their Nisei.
Hiroshima prefectural associations still active in Seattle (1901), San Francisco (1898), Sacramento (1906), Los Angeles (1910), Stockton, Berkeley, Fresno, Chicago, Salt Lake City, Colorado.
us_mainland.source: https://www.pref.hiroshima.lg.jp/uploaded/attachment/649748.pdf (PDF p.2 [printed p.52] (2) 在外広島県人会の状況)

us_mainland.fact: Prefecture-level counts for US-mainland emigrants specifically: null (not found in an official source during this research).

canada.fact: Around half of pre-war Japanese immigrants to British Columbia came from four prefectures: Hiroshima, Shiga, Wakayama and Kagoshima.

Mio village (now Mihama, Wakayama): Kuno Gihei went to Canada in 1888; the 加奈陀三尾村人会 in Steveston had 150 members in 1900 and 763 in 1936; Wakayama people ran 60-70% of BC fisheries at the time; Mio became "America-mura"; Canada Museum opened 2018.
JICA's 1994 statistics have no prefecture breakdown for Canada emigrants before FY1975 (counted under "other").

brazil.source: https://www.jica.go.jp/jomm/outline/ku57pq00000lx4th-att/list_01.pdf ; https://www.library.pref.okinawa.jp/about-okinawa/docs/646734ad8aba8524078d13cdb7630f24.pdf (p.3, citing 赤嶺園子『笠戸丸移民 未来へ継ぐ裔孫』2014)

placeHooks.hook: Hatta Yoichi (born Kanazawa 1886) joined the Taiwan Government-General in 1910 and built the Wushantou dam / Chianan irrigation; the Kanazawa Furusato Ijinkan presents him as "the man who watered Taiwan's land".
placeHooks.evidence: Taiwan is the No.1 foreign market in Ishikawa by guest nights 2025: 323,600 nights = 17.6% (LQ 1.36); Taiwan visit rate to Ishikawa 2.6% vs all-market 2.2%. Note: Europeans over-index far more (Italy LQ 4.46, Spain 3.68).

placeHooks.hook: Strongest regional over-index of any market (Taiwanese visitors dominate Tohoku foreign stays).
placeHooks.evidence: Taiwan = 45.3% of Miyagi, 51.1% of Iwate, 56.9% of Fukushima, 33.9% of Aomori foreign guest nights (2025); Taiwan visit rate Miyagi 4.1% vs all 1.3%.

placeHooks.place: Fujiyoshida (Yamanashi) - Chureito Pagoda / Arakurayama Sengen Park
placeHooks.hook: Mt Fuji + five-storey pagoda + cherry blossoms view; city says ~200,000 visit the spring festival each year and >10,000 foreign visitors/day at peak; festival cancelled for 2026 over overtourism. No official nationality split for the park itself.
placeHooks.evidence: Thai visit rate to Yamanashi 17.1% vs all-market 8.1% (2025); Thailand LQ 3.08 in Yamanashi guest nights; neighbouring Fujikawaguchiko town: Thailand 70,972 foreign guest nights = 9.8% (2024) vs Thailand's 2.7% share nationally (2025).
placeHooks.source: https://www.city.fujiyoshida.yamanashi.jp/uploaded/attachment/7151.pdf ; https://www.town.fujikawaguchiko.lg.jp/upload/file/kanko/R6nenpou.pdf (printed p.4, (3) 国籍別国外宿泊客数) ; https://www.mlit.go.jp/kankocho/content/001992581.xls ; https://www.mlit.go.jp/kankocho/content/002010340.xlsx

placeHooks.hook: Closest foreign market: ferries Busan-Hitakatsu/Izuhara (Tsushima) and Busan-Shimonoseki; historical Korea-Tsushima links (Joseon missions).
placeHooks.evidence: Korean visit rate Fukuoka 25.2% vs all 11.0%, Oita 8.0% vs 3.4%; Korea = 36.8% of Fukuoka and 31.3% of Nagasaki foreign guest nights; MOJ 2025 Korean entrants: Hitakatsu 226,102 (of 227,887), Izuhara 40,233, Kanmon/Shimonoseki 66,719, Fukuoka Airport 1,999,703.
placeHooks.source: https://www.mlit.go.jp/kankocho/content/001992581.xls ; https://www.mlit.go.jp/kankocho/content/002010340.xlsx ; https://www.e-stat.go.jp/stat-search/file-download?statInfId=000040476157&fileKind=4 (25-00-02 国籍・地域別 港別 入国外国人, 2025)

placeHooks.place: Sendai (Miyagi) - Lu Xun lecture hall; Nagasaki - Tojin yashiki / Shinchi Chinatown
placeHooks.hook: Lu Xun (Zhou Shuren) enrolled at Sendai Medical School in September 1904 (first foreign student at a Sendai government school); Tohoku Univ. keeps the lecture hall and a Lu Xun memorial exhibition and notes many visitors from China (e.g., Jiang Zemin, 1998). Nagasaki: Tojin yashiki (1689, ~9,400 tsubo, ~2,000 Chinese residents at a time), Shinchi Chinatown.
placeHooks.evidence: Hooks are real but current mass Chinese travel under-indexes there: China visit rate Miyagi 0.6% (all 1.3%), Nagasaki 0.3% (all 1.0%); China LQ Miyagi 0.69, Nagasaki 0.41. China over-indexes instead in Shizuoka (LQ 2.02), Wakayama (1.79), Hyogo (1.71), Yamanashi (1.33).

placeHooks.hook: Ski resort towns with long-staying Australians.
placeHooks.evidence: Kutchan FY2025 (Apr 2025-Mar 2026) foreign guest nights 899k (record); Australia No.1 with 166,822 nights (USA 121,503; Singapore 102,981; Hong Kong 102,842). Australian visit rate Hokkaido 9.9% vs all 7.3%, Nagano 15.9% vs 3.0%; Australia LQ Nagano 2.42. National hotel statistics under-capture Niseko condos (Australia LQ Hokkaido only 0.74).

placeHooks.place: Kyushu (Fukuoka, Oita, Kumamoto, Saga) and Hokkaido
placeHooks.hook: Heavy repeaters (90.6% repeat) who go regional.
placeHooks.evidence: 16.4% of Hong Kong guest nights are in Kyushu (7 prefectures) vs 7.8% for all markets; 10.4% in Hokkaido vs 7.3%. HK visit rates: Fukuoka 15.5%, Kumamoto 4.1%, Oita 4.9%, Hokkaido 6.9%. Hokkaido FY2024: 175,500 HK visitors (6.2% of foreign visitors to Hokkaido).
placeHooks.source: https://www.mlit.go.jp/kankocho/content/002010340.xlsx ; https://www.mlit.go.jp/kankocho/content/001992581.xls ; https://www.pref.hokkaido.lg.jp/fs/1/2/9/8/6/7/2/7/_/%E5%8C%97%E6%B5%B7%E9%81%93%E8%A6%B3%E5%85%89%E5%85%A5%E8%BE%BC%E8%AA%BF%E6%9F%BB%E5%A0%B1%E5%91%8A%E6%9B%B8(R6_%E6%9C%AC%E7%B7%A8).pdf (PDF p.4, ５．訪日外国人来道者数, table 令和６（2024）年度外国人来道者数)

placeHooks.place: Nagasaki (Glover House), Yokohama & Kobe foreign settlements, Hiroshima
placeHooks.hook: Thomas Blake Glover (Scottish) arrived in Nagasaki 1859; Glover House (1863) is Japan's oldest surviving Western-style wooden building and a World Heritage component (2015), requisitioned by US occupation forces after the war. Yokohama Foreign General Cemetery: ~5,000 people from 40+ countries, begun with a burial from Perry's squadron. Kobe settlement sewer (c.1872) designed by British engineer J.W. Hart.
placeHooks.evidence: UK visit rate Nagasaki 1.8% vs all 1.0%; Kanagawa 19.6% vs 9.3%; Hiroshima 19.6% vs 4.1% (UK LQ Hiroshima 3.3, Ishikawa 2.12). UK history/traditional-culture experience rate 74.7% (all markets 32.7%).

placeHooks.hook: Karuizawa was put on the map in 1886 by Canadian missionary Alexander Croft Shaw (first villa 1888; Shaw Memorial Chapel). Mio sent fishermen to Steveston BC from 1888 (Kuno Gihei).
placeHooks.evidence: Canada visit rate Nagano 5.2% vs all 3.0%; Wakayama 2.0% vs 1.2%; Canada LQ Hiroshima 1.52. Canadian Nikkei (129,430 ethnic-origin responses, 2021) have roots concentrated in Hiroshima, Shiga, Wakayama, Kagoshima.

placeHooks.place: Yoyogi Park (Washington Heights), Kurihama & Shimoda (Perry/Harris), US base towns
placeHooks.hook: Yoyogi Park: former army parade ground -> US military housing "Washington Heights" -> 1964 Olympic village -> park. Perry landed at Kurihama on 1853-07-14 (Kurihama tourism association); Perry Park monument erected 1901 with inscription by Ito Hirobumi, Perry Memorial Hall built for the city's 80th anniversary (Yokosuka City). Shimoda: first treaty port (1854); Townsend Harris opened the first US consulate at Gyokusenji in 1856. Perry's 1853 expedition also sketched Kin, Okinawa.
placeHooks.evidence: US visit rate Kanagawa 17.0% vs all 9.3% (USA LQ 1.64); Hiroshima 8.3% vs 4.1%; US share of foreign guest nights: Yamaguchi (Iwakuni) 14.8%, Okinawa 11.7%, Aomori (Misawa) 7.9%. US VFR share of visits 7.9% (all 4.0%). 54,891 US active-duty personnel in Japan (DMDC, 2026-03-31).

placeHooks.hook: Snow/ski and nature; high spenders (JPY 319,901 per person).
placeHooks.evidence: Singapore LQ Nagano 2.2, Niigata 1.78, Hokkaido 1.73; history/culture experience 41.8% (above all-market 32.7%).

gaps: Site-specific audience (Cloudflare) not available: all figures are market-level proxies.
MOFA 海外日系人数推計 PDF (country table) returns HTTP 403 to our fetchers; Brazil/Peru figures are taken from JICA publications that cite it; Canada/USA use national censuses instead.

US installation-level personnel: no official figure found for CFA Sasebo or Camp Hansen (Military OneSource has no number; navy.mil/marines.mil/usfj.mil return HTTP 403). Okinawa-specific counts are officially unavailable after June 2011.
Prefecture-of-origin counts by destination (e.g., US mainland only, Canada pre-1975) are not in the official JICA statistics; qualitative official statements used instead.
Peru Nikkei: only an approximate ~200,000 (JICA); the INEI 2017 census self-identification count for "Nikkei" was not found in an INEI table we could open.
JTA prefecture visit rates are from the B1 regional survey (airport/seaport departure sample); small markets (Russia n=192 base, Spain/Italy/India <1,000) have wide error margins.
宿泊旅行統計 nationality table covers only facilities with 10+ employees and marks cells with standard error >=30% (flag se_over_30pct_flag); it under-captures condos/vacation rentals (Niseko, Hakuba).
No official data on the number of former US service members / dependents who lived in Japan, or on Nikkei heritage travel volumes; these must be estimated from DMDC time series or surveyed directly.
Thailand-Chureito link: no official nationality split for Arakurayama Sengen Park; evidence is indirect (Yamanashi/Fujikawaguchiko over-index).
